label: Sendcloud
description: Send orders to Sendcloud (API v3) and sync tracking back to Swell. Create an integration in Sendcloud → Settings → Integrations → Sendcloud API and set its webhook URL using the pattern below.

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.description: Also used to verify the Sendcloud-Signature of incoming webhooks

fields.label: Integration ID
fields.description: ID of your Sendcloud API integration (shown in the integration's URL in the Sendcloud panel). Orders appear under this integration.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: Pattern of the webhook URL. Replace {store-id} with your store ID and {public-key} with your Swell public key, then paste it into Sendcloud → Settings → Integrations → Sendcloud API → Webhook URL and enable webhook feedback.

fields.label: Webhook Signature Key
fields.description: Optional. Only if your Sendcloud integration shows a separate Webhook Signature Key; otherwise the Secret Key is used.

fields.label: Skip test orders
fields.description: Skip orders placed in test mode (order.test) and orders with metadata.test set to true. Off by default, so existing stores keep the current behavior.

fields.label: Hold orders from a separate order schedule until their invoice is paid
fields.description: For an order of a subscription that ships on its own schedule (order_schedule differs from billing_schedule), wait until that shipment's invoice has status paid, and until the subscription is clear of arrears. Arrears means status pastdue or unpaid, or an earlier invoice with status pending or unpaid. A void invoice is ignored. The order then stays at Waiting for overdue payments. The order that created the subscription is sent on the paid or submitted event. A plan with no order_schedule, including a yearly plan, is not held. Send to Sendcloud can send while waiting and notes that on the order.

fields.label: Show the subscription plan on the packing slip
fields.description: Append the subscription plan to the item name on the packing slip, in the customer's language. One-off items are left unchanged. Off by default, so existing stores keep the current packing slip.

fields.label: Show bundle components on the packing slip
fields.description: Replace a bundle line with one line per component, named Bundle → Component. A subscription plan stays on the bundle name. Component names use the customer's language. The order total and the parcel weight stay the same. Off by default, so existing stores keep the current packing slip.

fields.label: Default shipping option code
fields.description: Optional. Preselects a Sendcloud shipping option on each order, e.g. postnl:standard

fields.label: Default parcel weight (kg)
fields.description: Used when order items have no shipment weight

fields.label: Create Swell shipment when label is created
fields.description: Fulfills the order in Swell with the Sendcloud tracking number

fields.label: Notify the customer when the shipment is created
fields.description: Sends Swell's orders.shipped notification when the label creates the shipment. On by default, the same as creating a shipment in the dashboard.
